scope: Four published batch-11 articles in desktop-dark/mobile-dark only: collapsed SourceQuote entry, actual mouse/touch open/close and exact original text/identity, Figure image/caption/timestamp, strict zero overflow. visualReview: Passed: all 10 main open-panel PNGs and one supplementary scrolled Bridge mobile PNG were individually opened via tools.view_image; eight main cases plus one targeted scroll check are recorded separately.
limitations: Chromium viewport/theme emulation, not a physical-device or reader comprehension study.
This batch uses dark themes only; no new light-theme or physical-device visual check is claimed.

Citation URLs and their hit targets are checked against metadata without external navigation. Figure image bytes match the pinned published originals; original-image navigation is outside this incremental run.

The shared citation interaction suite targets hover/keyboard/Escape/outside click/multiple-source/no-JS/fallback behavior. This batch repeats only actual desktop click/mobile tap open, source data and labelled-button close; it does not claim to rerun the complete shared suite.
Native figure links seek and pause as soon as seeking completes. No continuous/tail playback, old media QA replay or explicit full MP4 GET is performed.
CSS font/width checks do not replace actual screenshot review.

Horse A1 and new R1 were independently opened and viewed in each mode; the old institution/date entry and new credited author/fixed-source entry are not conflated.

limitations: Only dark desktop/mobile modes were newly checked; no physical-device or user comprehension/approval claim.
